Erie Indemnity said on Tuesday that President and Chief Executive Officer Timothy NeCastro retired on November 2, 2026.
The company added that Brian Bolash will serve as interim president and CEO, effective November 3, 2026.
Bolash, age 61, has served as the company’s executive vice president since January 2022 and served as secretary and general counsel since October 2019.

title: Erie Indemnity CEO retires, names new chief
